subject: chemistry

chapters.title: General topics
topics: Calculations (based on mole concept and stoichiometry) involving common oxidation-reduction, neutralisation, and displacement reactions
Concentration in terms of mole fraction, molarity, molality and normality.

units.title: States of Matter: Gases and Liquids

chapters.title: States of Matter: Gases and Liquids
topics: Gas laws and ideal gas equation, absolute scale of temperature
Deviation from ideality, van der Waals equation
Kinetic theory of gases, average, root mean square and most probable velocities and their relation with temperature
Intermolecular interactions: types, distance dependence, and their effect on properties
Liquids: vapour pressure, surface tension, viscosity.

chapters.title: Atomic Structure
topics: Bohr model, spectrum of hydrogen atom
Qualitative quantum mechanical picture of hydrogen atom: Energies, quantum numbers, wave function and probability density (plots only), shapes of s, p and d orbitals
Pauli’s exclusion principle and Hund’s rule.

chapters.title: Chemical Bonding and Molecular Structure
topics: Hybridisation involving s, p and d orbitals only
Molecular orbital energy diagrams for homonuclear diatomic species (up to Ne2 )
VSEPR model and shapes of molecules (linear, angular, triangular, square planar, pyramidal, square pyramidal, trigonal bipyramidal, tetrahedral and octahedral).

chapters.title: Chemical Thermodynamics
topics: Intensive and extensive properties, state functions, First law of thermodynamics
Internal energy, work (pressure-volume only) and heat
Enthalpy, heat capacity, standard state, Hess’s law
Enthalpy of reaction, fusion and vaporization, and lattice enthalpy

chapters.title: Chemical and Ionic Equilibrium
topics: Significance of ∆𝐺 and ∆𝐺⊖ in chemical equilibrium
Equilibrium constant (Kp and Kc ) and reaction quotient, Le Chatelier’s principle (effect of concentration, temperature and pressure)
Solubility product and its applications, common ion effect, pH and buffer solutions
Acids and bases (Brønsted and Lewis concepts)

chapters.title: Electrochemistry
topics: Electrochemical series, emf of galvanic cells
Electrolytic conductance, specific, equivalent and molar conductivity, Kohlrausch’s law
Batteries: Primary and Secondary, fuel cells

chapters.title: Chemical Kinetics
topics: Differential and integrated rate expressions for zero and first order reactions
Temperature dependence of rate constant (Arrhenius equation and activation energy)
Catalysis: Homogeneous and heterogeneous, activity and selectivity of solid catalysts, enzyme catalysis and its mechanism.

chapters.title: Solid State
topics: Classification of solids, crystalline state, seven crystal systems (cell parameters a, b, c, α, β, γ), close packed structure of solids (cubic and hexagonal), packing in fcc, bcc and hcp lattices
Nearest neighbours, ionic radii and radius ratio, point defects.

chapters.title: Solutions
topics: Colligative properties: lowering of vapour pressure, elevation of boiling point, depression of freezing point, and osmotic pressure

chapters.title: Surface Chemistry
topics: Elementary concepts of adsorption: Physisorption and Chemisorption, Freundlich adsorption isotherm
Colloids: types, methods of preparation and general properties
Elementary ideas of emulsions, surfactants and micelles (only definitions and examples).

units.title: Classification of Elements and Periodicity in Properties

chapters.title: Classification of Elements and Periodicity in Properties
topics: Modern periodic law and the present form of periodic table
periodic trends in atomic radius, ionic radius, ionization enthalpy, electron gain enthalpy, valence, oxidation states, electronegativity, and chemical reactivity.

chapters.title: Hydrogen
topics: Position of hydrogen in periodic table, occurrence, isotopes, preparation, properties and uses of hydrogen
physical and chemical properties of water, heavy water
hydrogen peroxide-preparation, reactions, use and structure

chapters.title: s-Block Elements
topics: Alkali and alkaline earth metals-reactivity towards air, water, dihydrogen, halogens, acids
their reducing nature including solutions in liquid ammonia
general characteristics of their oxides, hydroxides, halides, salts of oxoacids
anomalous behaviour of lithium and beryllium

preparation, properties, and uses of compounds of sodium (sodium carbonate, sodium chloride, sodium hydroxide, sodium hydrogen carbonate) and calcium (calcium oxide, calcium hydroxide, calcium carbonate, calcium sulphate).

chapters.title: p-Block Elements
topics: Oxidation state and trends in chemical reactivity of elements of groups 13-17
anomalous properties of boron, carbon, nitrogen, oxygen, and fluorine with respect to other elements in their respective groups.

chapters.title: Group 13
topics: Reactivity towards acids, alkalis, and halogens
preparation, properties, and uses of borax, orthoboric acid, diborane, boron trifluoride, aluminium chloride, and alums

chapters.title: Group 14
topics: allotropes of carbon and uses of carbon
preparation, properties, and uses of carbon monoxide, carbon dioxide, silicon dioxide, silicones, silicates, zeolites.

chapters.title: Group 15
topics: Reactivity towards hydrogen, oxygen, and halogen
preparation, properties, and uses of dinitrogen, ammonia, nitric acid, phosphine, phosphorus trichloride, phosphorus pentachloride
oxides of nitrogen and oxoacids of phosphorus.

chapters.title: Group 16
topics: Reactivity towards hydrogen, oxygen, and halogen
preparation/manufacture, properties, and uses of dioxygen, ozone, sulphur dioxide, sulfuric acid

chapters.title: Group 17
topics: Reactivity towards hydrogen, oxygen, and metals
preparation/manufacture, properties, and uses of chlorine, hydrogen chloride and interhalogen compounds

chapters.title: Group 18
topics: compounds of xenon with fluorine and oxygen.

chapters.title: d-Block Elements
topics: preparation, structure, and reactions of oxoanions of chromium and manganese.

chapters.title: Coordination Compounds
topics: Nomenclature, cis-trans and ionization isomerism, hybridization and geometries (linear, tetrahedral, square planar and octahedral) of mononuclear coordination compounds
Bonding [VBT and CFT (octahedral and tetrahedral fields)]
Magnetic properties (spin-only) and colour of 3d-series coordination compounds

chapters.title: Isolation of Metals
topics: extraction of crude metal from concentrated ores: thermodynamic (iron, copper, zinc) and electrochemical (aluminium) principles of metallurgy

chapters.title: Principles of Qualitative Analysis
topics: Groups I to V (only Ag+, Hg2+, Cu2+, Pb2+, Fe3+, Cr3+, Al3+, Ca2+, Ba2+, Zn2+, Mn2+ and Mg2+)
Nitrate, halides (excluding fluoride), carbonate and bicarbonate, sulphate and sulphide.

chapters.title: Basic Principles of Organic Chemistry
topics: Stereoisomers and stereochemical relationship (enantiomers, diastereomers, meso) of compounds containing only up to two asymmetric centres (R,S and E,Z configurations excluded)
Determination of empirical and molecular formulae of simple compounds by combustion method only
IUPAC nomenclature of organic molecules (hydrocarbons, including simple cyclic hydrocarbons and their mono-functional and bi-functional derivatives only)
Acidity and basicity of organic compounds
Reactive intermediates produced during homolytic and heterolytic bond cleavage
Formation, structure and stability of carbocations, carbanions and free radicals.

chapters.title: Alkanes
topics: Physical properties (melting points, boiling points and density) and effect of branching on them
Conformations of ethane and butane (Newman projections only)
Preparation from alkyl halides and aliphatic carboxylic acids
Reactions: combustion, halogenation (including allylic and benzylic halogenation) and oxidation.

chapters.title: Alkenes and Alkynes
topics: Physical properties (boiling points, density and dipole moments)
Acid catalysed hydration (excluding the stereochemistry of addition and elimination)
Reactions of alkenes with KMnO4 and ozone
Electrophilic addition reactions of alkenes with X2 , HX, HOX, (X=halogen)
Effect of peroxide on addition reactions

chapters.title: Benzene
topics: Electrophilic substitution reactions: halogenation, nitration, sulphonation, Friedel-Crafts alkylation and acylation
Effect of directing groups (monosubstituted benzene) in these reactions.

chapters.title: Phenols
topics: Preparation, Electrophilic substitution reactions of phenol (halogenation, nitration, sulphonation)
Oxidation and reduction reactions of phenol.

chapters.title: Alkyl Halides
topics: Nucleophilic substitution reactions and their stereochemical aspects.

chapters.title: Alcohols
topics: Reactions: esterification, dehydration (formation of alkenes and ethers)
Reactions with: sodium, phosphorus halides, ZnCl2 /concentrated HCl, thionyl chloride
Conversion of alcohols into aldehydes, ketones and carboxylic acids.

chapters.title: Aldehydes and Ketones
topics: Preparation of: aldehydes and ketones from acid chlorides and nitriles
Reactions: oxidation, reduction, oxime and hydrazone formation
Nucleophilic addition reaction with RMgX, NaHSO3 , HCN, alcohol, amine.

chapters.title: Carboxylic Acids
topics: Preparation: from nitriles, Grignard reagents, hydrolysis of esters and amides
Preparation of benzoic acid from alkylbenzenes
Reactions: reduction, halogenation, formation of esters, acid chlorides and amides.

chapters.title: Amines
topics: Preparation from nitro compounds, nitriles and amides
Reactions: Hoffmann bromamide degradation, Gabriel phthalimide synthesis
Reaction with nitrous acid, Azo coupling reaction of diazonium salts of aromatic amines
Sandmeyer and related reactions of diazonium salts
Carbylamine reaction, Hinsberg test, Alkylation and acylation reactions.

chapters.title: Haloarenes
topics: Nucleophilic aromatic substitution in haloarenes and substituted haloarenes (excluding benzyne mechanism and cine substitution).

chapters.title: Carbohydrates
topics: Glycoside formation and hydrolysis of disaccharides (sucrose, maltose, lactose)

chapters.title: Nucleic acids
topics: Chemical composition and structure of DNA and RNA.

chapters.title: Chemistry in Everyday Life
topics: Therapeutic action, and examples (excluding structures), of antacids, antihistamines, tranquilizers, analgesics, antimicrobials, and antifertility drugs

chapters.title: Practical Organic Chemistry
topics: Detection and identification of the following functional groups: hydroxyl (alcoholic and phenolic), carbonyl (aldehyde and ketone), carboxyl, amino and nitro.

notes: Edition: 'JEE (Advanced) 2026 Syllabus' from jeeadv.ac.in/documents/jee-advanced-2026-syllabus.pdf. The PDF's first line: 'Note: The syllabus for JEE Advanced 2026 remains the same as JEE Advanced 2025.' No JEE Advanced 2027 syllabus or brochure exists on jeeadv.ac.in as of 2026-10-12 (jee-advanced-2027-syllabus.pdf and IBEnglish_2027.pdf return 404; the site still shows the 2026 cycle).

The source has headings with paragraphs, no numbering, no marks. Each heading is a unit (number null) with one chapter repeating its title; where a paragraph begins with its own sub-heading ('Group 13:' ... 'Group 18:' in p-Block Elements, 'Carbohydrates:', 'Proteins:', 'Nucleic acids:' in Biomolecules) that paragraph is its own chapter. topics[] = the semicolon-separated items as printed (also split at full stops that start a new sentence).

In 'Chemical and Ionic Equilibrium' the symbol after '∆' is U+1D43A MATHEMATICAL ITALIC CAPITAL G ('∆𝐺', '∆𝐺⊖'), recovered losslessly from the text layer's CESU-8 surrogate pair (main-thread fix 2026-10-12; an earlier decoding showed it as U+FFFD).
Subscripts are extracted as separate tokens, e.g. 'Equilibrium constant (Kp and Kc ) and reaction quotient', 'KMnO4 and ozone'.
